title: Guided Launchpad: collapsible hero + progressive step-flow for Quickstart landing
creator: Sofia Kim
description: Design and deliver a new Quickstart landing hero that behaves like a 'guided launchpad': a collapsible hero that surfaces the 3 primary onboarding paths (API quickstart, SDK examples, Console walkthrough) and progressively reveals step-by-step microflows and annotated product screenshots. The goal is to reduce time-to-first-success and increase activation by making the initial steps feel contextual and lightweight for engineers and PMs.
acceptance_criteria: New hero prototypes (desktop/tablet/mobile) created in Figma and handed off with tokens and layout specs
Collapsible hero behavior documented with animation spec, accessibility focus states, and keyboard interactions
Three annotated step-flows (API key, sample request, first token) with production screenshots and copy approved by PM
Automated screenshot export pipeline configured for 3 breakpoints and 2 themes (light/dark), with naming conventions matching release assets
Design QA checklist passed and final assets uploaded to Drive + links added to docs PR
Stakeholder review sign-off (PM, Eng, Docs) recorded in comments
